text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the URA Finals, an interview 
with reporter Otonashi was scheduled.

Despite getting swept up in Reporter 
Otonashi's terrifying pressure, you 
declared your dedication to <chrname> as their 
Trainer.

However, to become a "Star Umamusume," she 
still doesn't have nearly enough fans...

Once more, they renewed their 
determination.

Fans are steadily gathering, all looking 
forward to the "Star Umamusume."

Vowing to keep up the momentum, they 
steeled themselves for what lay ahead.

Things went smoothly in the early stages, 
producing great results toward becoming a 
"Star Umamusume."

She firmly resolved that she had to 
maintain this momentum.
